subject: art-and-design
topicName: Art Craft and Design Making Connections

questions.question: Create a series of experimental studies exploring art craft and design making connections. Annotate your process.

points.text: A range of experimental studies showing different approaches to art craft and design making connections, each annotated with media, technique and purpose. Show development from initial experiments to refined outcomes.

questions.question: Research an artist or designer who works with art craft and design making connections. Write a critical analysis of their approach and explain how it has informed your own work.

points.text: A critical analysis naming a specific artist/designer, using specialist vocabulary, explaining their context and approach, and making clear connections to personal work.

questions.question: Evaluate the effectiveness of your experiments with art craft and design making connections. Which approaches were most successful and why?

points.text: A reflective evaluation identifying successful and less successful experiments, explaining WHY using technical and conceptual language, and showing how evaluation led to further refinement.

points.text: A grade 9 response will: work confidently in at least two disciplines; show depth of development in each area; explain how the disciplines connect and inform each other; create a coherent portfolio linked by a strong theme; annotate with vocabulary from each discipline.
